_comment: Everything the frontend gates are currently told to ignore, who answers
Keys are '<source>::<entry>'. The register is never written by a
--write-baseline run, so regenerating a baseline cannot lose it.
An entry right by design carries no date. One that waits for a fix carries
`expires`; past it the gate warns and names the owner, and refuses nothing.

knip.json:ignore::src/types/api-generate.reason: Structural: generated from the backend schema and checked in for the type checker, so nothing imports it at runtime.
